coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet
Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
Getting dressed and grooming at the desk
Setting up the telehealth workstation on the computer and reviewing the day's patient schedule, since the transport strike prevents commuting to the clinic
Conducting telehealth consultations with patients and updating clinical notes on the computer
Preparing a quick lunch in the microwave and eating it during a work break
Continuing telehealth patient consultations, following up on test results and completing documentation on the computer
Taking a shower and freshening up after the workday
Loading and running the washing machine for a load of laundry
Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating it
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV after dinner
Evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
Wind-down time reading on the phone with the desk lamp on
